crossRefs.note: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through…
They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.
When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.
Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

translations.web: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.
translations.bsb: But Jesus passed through the crowd and went on His way.
translations.kjv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way,
translations.asv: But he passing through the midst of them went his way.
